global_model.finding: CA2/CA3/CA4/CA6 and CA7 share Hero/Pet owner state_version intentionally as the coherence fence while durable columns/child tables remain narrowly owned. CA5 uses separate saved-reference authority.
global_model.no_claim: Static narrow-write evidence does not replace required real cross-service tests or CA7-7 native concurrency proof.

rows.accepted_scope: Asset Kernel, transaction composition and typed materialization
rows.preservation_finding: CA7 reuses caller-owned transaction, typed I5 composition, D11 receipts and Character owner CAS seams; no new foreign-owner SQL or parallel economy owner is required.
ca7_6_required_proof: architecture guard: no foreign-owner SQL in CA7 contribution seam
typed Commerce materializer remains caller-transaction-owned
no new aggregate/scheduler/transaction runner for CA8 contribution

rows.accepted_scope: Hero Core Identity, Roster & Base Progression
rows.preservation_finding: Hero progression writes star/level/exp (or broader progression/equipment fields) plus state_version but do not write CA7 selectors/entitlement tables. CA7 writes selectors/child entitlements plus the same owner state_version but do not rewrite progression identity fields.
ca7_6_required_proof: real CA2 progression mutation preserves CA7 durable appearance
real CA7 mutation preserves Hero identity/progression fields
contribution carries canonical owner identity as validation evidence without becoming roster authority

rows.accepted_scope: Pet Core Identity, Roster & Base Progression
rows.preservation_finding: Pet show/progression/equipment writes narrow owned fields plus state_version; CA7 Pet style writes active_style/child rows plus state_version. Neither query family rewrites the other owned columns.
ca7_6_required_proof: real CA3 Pet mutation preserves CA7 style ownership/selector
real CA7 Pet mutation preserves Pet identity/progression/show/equipment fields

rows.preservation_finding: Hero/Pet equipment and Fumo share the owner row/version but use narrow progression/equipment columns; CA7 appearance writes do not overwrite equipment/Fumo columns. CA4 raw downstream state is owner-versioned and caller-queryer/exact-revision qualified.
ca7_6_required_proof: equipment/Fumo mutation preserves CA7 state
CA7 mutation preserves equipment/Fumo state
CA8 same-snapshot observations agree on owner StateVersion or fail closed

rows.preservation_finding: CA5 saved presets are separate root/lane/Hero-reference tables with an independent root revision; CA7 does not write these tables. CA5 references identify Character owners and do not own Character appearance.
ca7_6_required_proof: CA7 mutation leaves saved-reference bytes/root revision unchanged
saved-reference mutation leaves CA7 owner/child state unchanged
CA8 joins references to Character contributions without transferring ownership

rows.accepted_scope: Practice / Wash Proposal-Save Progression — pending MANUAL/TICKET
rows.preservation_finding: Pending proposal stores ActorStateVersion. SAVE locks Character owner first, then proposal, rejects on version mismatch before Practice CAS or proposal deletion. Real CA7 mutation therefore stales pending MANUAL/TICKET; semantic CA7 no-op preserves validity.
ca7_6_required_proof: actual Hero CA7 mutation -> pending MANUAL/TICKET SAVE stale
actual Pet CA7 mutation -> pending MANUAL/TICKET SAVE stale
semantic CA7 no-op -> proposal remains saveable
stale rejection occurs before Practice apply/delete

rows.preservation_finding: TICKET prepares/applies one stack debit in generation transaction before proposal upsert/receipt. A later stale SAVE has no debit/refund path and rejects before proposal delete, so committed generation ticket remains spent and stale proposal remains.
ca7_6_required_proof: after CA7 stales a TICKET proposal, SAVE performs no second debit
stale SAVE performs no refund of generation ticket
stale proposal remains present after rejected SAVE

rows.preservation_finding: AUTO never creates a pending proposal. It locks the same Hero/Pet owner through lockTarget before accounting/apply. CA7 and AUTO therefore require serialization/no torn state, not proposal-staleness semantics.

symbols: AUTO never creates a CA6-3 pending proposal

ca7_6_required_proof: application-level CA7-vs-AUTO ordering serializes on the same owner seam
either serialized order preserves both applicable states and one version transition per mutation
no invented AUTO proposal invalidation
rows.native_limit: Exact PostgreSQL concurrent row-lock proof remains at CA7-7 accumulated native gate.
